description: Frappe versions before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 have a prototype pollution vulnerability. This flaw allows Dashboard Manager users to inject properties into Object.prototype via specially crafted Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user views the affected dashboard, the client merges these malicious properties, altering client behavior for that session.
